title: PortCls adapter start-path diagnostic logging

summary.behavior: StartDevice now logs entry/exit and null-parameter failures; RegisterSubdevices logs per-endpoint register begin and failure with endpoint index; PcRegisterSubdevice success logs at TRACE level instead of ERROR; AddDevice logs PcAddAdapterDevice result; miniport InitEndpoint and GetDescription log stage entry, failure cause and success. All logging is DbgPrintEx on the control/start path only; no RT-path allocation, lock, wait, file, COM or UI was added.
summary.motivation: Isolated VM load test recorded reproducible CM_PROB_FAILED_START / 0xC000000D without stage localization (driver-vm-load-test-v1.json); its next_safe_action asked for PortCls start-path diagnosis against the merged descriptor fixes.

validation.notes: HibikiVirtualAudio.sys linked; Inf2Cat signability complete with 0 errors. Warnings are pre-existing only: C4083 vcruntime/stdint headers, C4996 ExAllocatePoolWithTag deprecation, C4189 unused latency_100ns, LNK4042 duplicate guids.obj.

scope: driver start/control-path diagnostics only; no ABI, topology, DSP or streaming behavior change; no live probe executed and no machine-state change
limits: Build and offline gates do not prove successful device start; the next isolated VM load test consumes these DbgPrintEx stages to localize any remaining CM_PROB_FAILED_START cause.
